data.title: 白金 · 水雾氤氲的沐后私语
data.description: 【大理石浴室·夜间】温热的水汽在大理石墙壁和镜面上凝结成细密水珠。白金单手扶着镜台，另一只手拿着干毛巾轻拭着湿漉漉的发梢，白皙双颊被热气熏染得微红，眼波流转间带着一丝羞涩的嗔怪。
data.location: 大理石雾气浴室梳妆镜前
data.action: 手执毛巾擦拭湿发抚弄耳际
data.lighting: 雾气漫射的乳白顶灯与镜前柔光
data.promptProse: Inside a warm marble bathroom misted with post-bath steam and beaded condensation on the vanity mirror, Platinum braces one hand on the counter while patting her damp white hair with a hand towel. Wrapped snugly in a fluffy white bath towel with water droplets glistening along her bare shoulders, she glances shyly toward the viewer with heat-flushed cheeks.
data.animaCaption: Standing before the fogged marble vanity mirror with one hand braced on the counter, she dabs her damp hair with a small towel and casts a shy flushed glance toward the viewer. Warm steam softens the overhead light on her wet shoulders above the wrapped white bath towel.
data.nsfwProse: She wears only a fluffy white bath towel tucked snugly above her bust, her bare shoulders and collarbone glistening with warm droplets.
